verdict.rationale: Plaid documents subscribable Identity Verification webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) that deliver real-time alerts on session changes, so a backend can react to status outcomes without polling. The evidence does not show webhook signing or an explicit mapping to the named lifecycle states. missing for 10: evidence of signed or verifiable webhook payloads, explicit created/processing/verified/requires-input event semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, verification lifecycle events arrive as signed webhooks — created, processing, verified, requires-input — so my system reacts to outcomes without polling

citations.quote: You can select which events you want to subscribe to. For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
Subscribe to events and get real-time alerts for changes
